name: Koi Iro Crescendo ~Princess Diva of Convallaria~
original_name: 恋色クレシェンド 〜Princess Diva of Convallaria〜
source:
I thought it was love at first sight. When you smiled, my heart pounded and my cheeks turned hot. I won't ever, ever forget that... Today, I got to see you. Today, I got to talk to you. Today, today, today, today... With these little things piling up, I'm getting to know you.

The princess diva of Convallaria sang of love again today.

I love you, and these feelings won't change, but little by little, bit by bit, something is changing. I thought it was love at first sight. Beautifully and tenderly, longing for my senpai. That's what I thought. As the days have gone by, this feeling has gradually grown, and I've finally begun to notice it...

[Translated from [url=http://maidens-gene.sakura.ne.jp/game/koicre/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
我以为那是一见钟情。

你微笑时，我的心怦怦直跳，脸颊也变得滚烫。我永远、永远不会忘记那一刻……

今天，我见到了你。

今天，我和你说了话。

今天，今天，今天，今天……

这些微小的事情一点点累积，让我开始了解你。

康乃馨的公主歌姬今天也唱起了恋歌。

我爱你，这份感情不会改变，但一点一点、一步一步，有什么东西正在变化。

我以为那是一见钟情。美丽而温柔地憧憬着我的学姐。我当时是这样认为的。

随着日子流逝，这份感情逐渐成长，最后，我终于开始察觉到它……

[译自 [url=http://maidens-gene.sakura.ne.jp/game/koicre/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
